mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( user_id, name, login_id, nickname, email, profile_image_url, created_at, password ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{name}, #{loginId}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{profileImageUrl}, NOW(), #{password} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, name, login_id, nickname, email, profile_image_url, created_at, updated_at, password, user_status, point FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND user_status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT user_id, name, login_id, nickname, email, profile_image_url, created_at, updated_at, password, user_status, point FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET nickname = #{nickname}, profile_image_url = #{profileImageUrl}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET password = #{password}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET user_status = 'DEACTIVATED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
